# OpenSSL 3.5.9

The local Windows GUI build uses OpenSSL 3.5.9, distributed under the Apache License 2.0. The accompanying `LICENSE` is from the OpenSSL 3.5.9 source release.

Source: https://github.com/openssl/openssl/releases/tag/openssl-3.5.9

The source archive used for this build is `openssl-3.5.9.tar.gz`, SHA-256 `603f5602e2eef00d77fbd429d34dcd5822bb301757a1bc9cdb24c670f1eb859a`. The Qt configuration selects static OpenSSL libraries. Other builds may use different OpenSSL versions.
